observed_error: RuntimeError: existing H seal backup receipt mismatch
root_cause: no-op pending-delta backup acquires RunLease and rewrites RUN_STATE.json timestamps; deterministic H state seal previously included RUN_STATE.json and was regenerated before consulting the existing dual-backup receipt
fix: skip backup_pending when pending_delta_hashes is empty
exclude RUN_STATE.json from newly-created deterministic H pair-state seals
if a dual-readback seal receipt already exists, reuse the backed seal instead of regenerating it
if the local seal was overwritten before the mismatch was detected, restore it from a receipt-recorded remote object and verify SHA/size plus scientific pair/aggregate/identity payload
claim_ceiling: durability/resume repair only; no scientific threshold or arithmetic changes
